quotes.quote: Selling in an uptrend.
quotes.why: His three-word diagnosis of every large loss on 2026-07-31, the day the demo went $1000 to $309. No numeric trend filter ever caught them; his eyes caught all three.

quotes.quote: In a strong trend even a weak setup works.
quotes.why: Trend quality outranks candle quality. Judge the context first, the geometry second.

quotes.quote: This setup is choppy market — we don't take trades in a ranging market.
quotes.why: The most frequent avoidable loss. When highs and lows are flat, stand aside.

quotes.quote: AI khud kyun ni pakadti trend?
quotes.why: The question that ended six months of tuning. Vision replaced the trend filter the same day, and beat the rule engine by $132 on the same six real trades.

quotes.quote: Hum wheel dobara bana rahe hain.
quotes.why: Said while watching another threshold sweep. He was right: no setting both blocked the killers and kept the winners.

quotes.quote: Apologies don't pay hospital bills.
quotes.why: Nine EA versions, $0 earned. 'The next version will fix it' IS the failure mode. Only live receipts count.

quotes.quote: We ride the wave and surf into profit for 5-6 trades, then when the trend shifts we make a huge loss.
quotes.why: Measured: one full-size loss eats 6.2 average winners. Avoiding killers beats catching winners.

quotes.quote: Greed has no measurement — 40 students, none succeeded.
quotes.why: Every safety rule must be enforced by the machine, never by a human's promise.

quotes.quote: Master takes the exit, the computer takes the entry.
quotes.why: The strategy is deterministic at entry and judgemental at exit. Nine versions automated the entry and never assembled the exit.

quotes.quote: Harvest, then withdraw. The market takes back what it gives.
quotes.why: At the daily target, stop. This was learned on the day of the 94% run.

quotes.quote: UHV means Ultra High Volume — it must be higher than its closest neighbours, and it must be a strong candle, so that when we mitigate it we are mitigating strong sellers.
quotes.why: A weak-bodied 'UHV' means nobody was exhausted, and the setup has no fuel.

quotes.quote: A valid retracement starts when a candle's BODY breaks the previous candle's extreme.
quotes.why: Not a wick, not a touch. The body.

quotes.quote: The breakout must have LOWER volume than the UHV.
quotes.why: Higher volume on the breakout means the move is being fought, not accepted.

quotes.quote: Show me the losing setups so I can comment on them.
quotes.why: Every genuine improvement in this system came from his comments on losers. Not one came from a parameter sweep.

quotes.quote: All backtests hallucinate.
quotes.why: Confirmed the hard way: the simulator scored a -$690 day at +$942 and called a -$120 trade a winner. Validate on real fills only.

quotes.quote: Zee's eye is ground truth
quotes.why: Mechanise it; never overrule it.

quotes.quote: The simulator lies
quotes.why: Validate on real fills only.

quotes.quote: A big loss eats ten small wins
quotes.why: Avoiding killers beats catching winners.

quotes.quote: Skipping a winner is cheap; taking a killer is not
quotes.why: When unsure, SKIP.

quotes.quote: One change at a time
quotes.why: , then live evidence.

quotes.quote: Demo until proven
quotes.why: Real money only on Zee's explicit word.

quotes.quote: Say it straight
quotes.why: If it is losing, say so, with the receipts.

quotes.quote: Exit is the edge
quotes.why: 83 % of entries reached +6 pt; the exit decided the outcome.

quotes.quote: Detect on the exchange feed, execute on the broker
quotes.why: Volume source is not a detail.

quotes.quote: Never trade stale data
quotes.why: A hours-old setup at a live price is a donation.
